audience: maintenance managers and technicians who run tasks and work requests in Maintainly

useCases.title: Review the open maintenance tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks of the organisation, filtered by status, type or due date. Open one task to read its work logs, materials and checklists.

useCases.title: Review work requests raised for assets
useCases.text: List the work requests that report problems, with their status. Open one request to read its description, reporter details and linked task.

useCases.title: Assign or reassign a task
useCases.text: Read the users assigned to a task and the users who are not. Then set the assignees, sending every user who should stay assigned.

useCases.title: Post an update on a task
useCases.text: Add a comment to a task. Everyone who can see the task can read the comment.

useCases.title: Report a new problem as a work request
useCases.text: Create a work request for a problem at an asset or location. It starts as open and can become a task after review.
